package main

import (

	"time"

type entry struct {
	value     string
	expiresAt time.Time

type Store struct {
	mu      sync.RWMutex
	data    map[string]*entry
	stopCh  chan struct{}
	sweeper *time.Ticker
}

func NewStore() *Store {
	s := &Store{
		data:   make(map[string]*entry),
		stopCh: make(chan struct{}),
	}
	s.sweeper = time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
	go s.sweepLoop()
	return s
}

func (s *Store) sweepLoop() {
	for {
		select {
		case <-s.sweeper.C:
			s.sweep()
		case <-s.stopCh:
			s.sweeper.Stop()
			return
		}
	}
}

	defer s.mu.Unlock()
